TextArena Environment (Wordle)

Space · sergiopaniego/wordle

Play TextArena text games such as Wordle by sending guesses and reading feedback.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • text game RL
  • OpenEnv wrapper example

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Dense, per step

Rewards come from the underlying TextArena game; for Wordle, positive reward for winning plus signals for green and yellow letter matches.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

docker build -t textarena-env:latest -f server/Dockerfile .

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/sergiopaniego/wordle
cd wordle

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.

Framework documentation: OpenEnv. Needs: Docker.
